title: Vibrant Juicy Filipino Buckwheat Noodles
description: A salty, juicy, and festive Filipino dish featuring buckwheat flour, beurre-monte, and Buddhist-temple-friendly ingredients, this vibrant noodle dish is perfect for any occasion. It combines the nutty flavor of buckwheat with the richness of beurre-monte and the brightness of Filipino spices.
instructions: Cook the buckwheat noodles according to package instructions and set aside.
In a large pan, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the onion until translucent.
Add the garlic and ginger to the pan and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Stir in the beurre-monte and cook for 2 minutes, until fragrant.
Add the soy sauce, calamansi juice, salt, and black pepper to the pan and stir to combine.
Add the cooked noodles to the pan and toss to coat with the sauce.
Cook for an additional 2 minutes, until the noodles are well coated.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of toasted buckwheat flour.
Refrigerate or freeze any leftovers for up to 3 days.
Reheat the noodles in a pan with a little water or oil until warmed through.
